comment: Primary GEO GSE313246 sample GSM9364621, library SC415_1, source clonotype sample0_clonotype201. The deposited title identifies the RNF43_3 dextramer-sorted population; published TableS1A independently identifies donor S8 and this sort group. Literal peptide and allele crosswalk is from the matching primary experiment in WO2025117509A1 Table1 (PDF page79), with explicit restriction statements in paragraphs280-281. Use only productive, high-confidence cell contigs and chain combinations co-observed within a source barcode. These are binding-sort observations; population functional assays do not verify every receptor separately. Source frequency counts the 3 cells of this clonotype among 7106 cells in the sorted library, after the reported short-term culture. Repeated counts across candidate rows describe the same source clonotype and must not be summed as independent support. Several chains are reported for this source clonotype; the selected candidate does not resolve which functional pair mediates binding. The raw cell contig reports CALSDTSGTYKYIF whereas the explicit clonotype summary reports CALSETSGTYKYIF. This raw-contig variant is preserved outside the positive build until the source discrepancy is resolved; no residue is silently corrected.
